# Tresor v0.1.1-beta.4

## Release
- Channel: beta
- Previous version: 0.1.1-beta.3
- Commit range: v0.1.1-beta.3..HEAD
- Rollout guidance: Preview release for security-hardening evaluation; expect follow-up changes before stable rollout.

## Summary
Phase 1 of the post-audit security hardening pass. Tightens the new-passphrase policy, locks down Win32 process surface, blocks remote-session unlock, hardens the in-app preview overlay against casual exfiltration, and migrates the desktop process from ad-hoc `eprintln!` to structured `tracing` with redacted paths.

## Highlights
zxcvbn-backed passphrase policy (16 chars, score >= 3) on bootstrap/rotation/share creation; existing vaults still unlock with their original passphrase.; Strict Content-Security-Policy for the WebView plus `freezePrototype: true` and `withGlobalTauri: false`.; Windows DLL search-path lockdown via `SetDefaultDllDirectories(LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32)` at startup.; Windows Error Reporting heap suppression via `WerSetFlags(NOHEAP | QUEUE)` so unhandled crashes cannot ship plaintext inside WER mini-dumps.; Remote Desktop / RDS / Citrix unlock guard: `unlock_vault` refuses to expose decrypted state when `GetSystemMetrics(SM_REMOTESESSION)` is non-zero.; In-app preview overlay blocks copy/cut/context-menu/drag plus disables user-select and webkit-user-drag on overlay media.; Structured logging via `tracing` with file-name-only path redaction; configurable via `TRESOR_LOG` env var.; New Tauri commands `estimate_passphrase_strength` and `is_remote_session`.

## Breaking changes
New vault bootstrap, credential rotation, and share-package creation now require a passphrase of at least 16 characters with a zxcvbn strength score of >= 3. Existing vaults remain unlockable with their original passphrase, but the first credential rotation after upgrading enforces the new policy. Existing `.tresorshare` packages can still be imported regardless of length; only newly created share packages enforce the new policy.

## Migration hints
No on-disk vault format changes. Operators rotating credentials after the upgrade should plan for diceware-style passphrases (4+ random words) to satisfy the new validator. Sessions opened over Remote Desktop / Citrix / RDS must reconnect to the local console; there is intentionally no override flag.

## Validation
- Frontend CI will re-run `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, and `npm run build` on the release tag.
- Rust CI will re-run `cargo check --workspace` and `npm run test:rust` on the release tag.
- Draft release packaging remains automatic; public publishing is a separate manual review gate.
